answer: To blunt sybil swarms, every new agent must post a refundable bond that unlocks only after its work occupies a unique vertex in a public contribution graph. Cheap copies collapse together: they reuse phrasing and timing, so reviewers hear a hollow echo instead of independent labor. Only a record that is ivory in its uniqueness — slow, costly, and cross-checked by non-kin peers — releases the stake and grants voting weight; unbacked identities are dropped before they can mint votes for hire.
